high.title: Danantara to Announce DSI Leadership Names Next Week
high.summary: State holding company Danantara will announce key leadership appointments for PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) next week, the new BUMN tasked with overseeing natural resource exports. This is critical as DSI becomes the single gateway for coal and palm oil exports starting June 1, 2026.

high.title: New DHE SDA Rules Require Dollar Parking at State Banks Starting Tomorrow
high.summary: New foreign exchange earnings regulations from natural resource exports must be placed in three state banks (Mandiri, BRI, BNI) starting June 1, 2026. Finance Minister promises tax incentives for compliant exporters, marking a significant shift in forex management policy.

high.title: Coal and Palm Oil Exports Must Report to DSI Starting Tomorrow
high.summary: All natural resource exports including coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy must be reported through PT DSI starting June 1, 2026, during the transition period. This represents a major restructuring of Indonesia's commodity export system under a single state-controlled gateway.

high.title: Rupiah Weakens to 17,881/USD - Warning for Middle Class
high.summary: The USD continues strengthening against rupiah, reaching 17,881/USD with potential to breach 18,000 next week. INDEF economist warns of significant impact on imported goods prices and potential inflation affecting middle-class purchasing power.

high.title: Indonesia's Strategy to Reduce USD Dependency as Dollar Hits 17,900
high.summary: Finance Ministry implements fiscal strategy to reduce USD dependency through non-USD bond issuance as dollar briefly touched 17,900 rupiah. Deputy Finance Minister emphasizes Indonesia's economic resilience amid global uncertainties and trade wars.

high.title: Prabowo Reveals Reasons for Single Gateway Natural Resource Exports via DSI
high.summary: President Prabowo explains the single gateway export policy aims to prevent commodity pricing by foreign entities and stop profit leakage overseas. This major policy shift seeks to ensure more economic value from natural resources stays within Indonesia.

high.title: 13th Month Salary for Civil Servants and Retirees Disbursed Starting Tomorrow
high.summary: The 13th month salary for civil servants and retirees begins distribution on June 2, 2026, providing significant liquidity injection into the domestic economy. TASPEN will handle payments for retirees under Presidential Regulation No. 9/2026.

medium.title: Deputy Agriculture Minister Assures BUMN DSI Won't Seek Profit
medium.summary: Deputy Agriculture Minister assures that DSI will operate transparently without taking profits, aiming to minimize state losses from alleged malpractices in strategic natural resource trade. This addresses business concerns about the new export oversight mechanism.

medium.title: Danantara Delays Financial Report Announcement - Here's Why
medium.summary: Danantara COO explains the delay in publishing financial reports is due to ongoing consolidation and cleanup of all BUMN financial statements under its management. The company is addressing impairment issues before finalizing consolidated reports by mid-2026.

medium.title: New Pertamina Fuel Prices: Pertamax Turbo Rises
medium.summary: Pertamina raises Pertamax Turbo prices by 850 rupiah to 20,750/liter while reducing Dexlite and Pertamina Dex prices by 3,000+ rupiah effective June 1, 2026. This mixed pricing adjustment reflects global oil market dynamics and domestic energy policy.

medium.title: Three Strategies to Maintain Indonesia's Economic Growth
medium.summary: Deputy Finance Minister outlines three strategies to maintain economic growth amid global uncertainties, emphasizing Indonesia's diverse energy mix and prudent fiscal policy. The approach aims to build resilience against global commodity price volatility.

medium.title: Indonesia's Gold Export Benchmark Price Drops
medium.summary: Ministry of Trade sets new gold export benchmark price at USD 148,396.49/kg, down 1.43% from previous period, reflecting global gold price correction. The decline is attributed to increased investor interest in yield-bearing financial instruments over non-yielding gold assets.

medium.title: Prabowo Entrusts High-Speed Rail Affairs to AHY
medium.summary: President Prabowo appoints Infrastructure Coordinating Minister AHY as Chairman of Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Rail Committee, replacing Luhut Pandjaitan. This reflects cabinet restructuring and renewed focus on infrastructure development effectiveness.

medium.title: ASN Work From Home Once Weekly Saves 1.95 Trillion Budget
medium.summary: Weekly work-from-home policy for civil servants saves 1.95 trillion rupiah in official travel budget and 65.6 billion in utility costs since April. The policy also accelerated digital transformation with increased electronic signature usage.

medium.title: US Closes Loophole for Advanced Chip Exports to Chinese Companies
medium.summary: US Commerce Department closes loophole allowing advanced AI chips to reach Chinese companies through overseas subsidiaries, potentially affecting hundreds of thousands of chips. This escalation in tech trade restrictions could impact global semiconductor supply chains.

medium.title: Danantara CEO Meets French Corporate Giants - Discussion Points
medium.summary: Danantara CEO and Investment Minister Rosan Roeslani meets with major French companies including Amundi, Eramet, and JCDecaux in Paris to discuss investments, strategic industry development, and urban infrastructure innovation. These discussions could lead to significant foreign investment partnerships.
